options.title: A — Everyday Commuter
options.details: Subject: adult civilian with warm brown skin and short dark rounded hair. Compact boxy coral windbreaker with petrol shoulder yoke, ivory plain crew-neck shirt, straight dark teal trousers and chunky ivory sneakers. Small flat slate cross-body everyday bag close to one hip, broad simple strap. Relaxed hands, no handheld items. Head and contrasting shoulder patch readable from above. Silhouette: compact squared shoulders, short jacket hem, clear gap between arms and torso; no hood covering the head.
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original pedestrian concept sheet for an irreverent top-down city game.
Style: smooth stylized 3D, chunky adult human proportions, broad soft bevels and continuous shading, readable massing, matte opaque clothing, minimal texture noise. Ordinary civilian city resident in a vibrant darker petrol/emerald city with coral, cobalt, amber and warm ivory accents. Cyberpunk colour energy from street lighting, not tactical gear. No real brands, logos, weapons, armour, dystopian implants or floating UI.
Composition: landscape concept sheet on quiet dark blue-grey backdrop, one large full-body front three-quarter design, smaller back view, a clearly separated TRUE VERTICAL OVERHEAD view looking straight down at crown/head/shoulders/back and shoes, and a row of four tiny overhead walking silhouettes facing north/east/south/west. The overhead studies are essential: do not use an isometric angle for them. Same character/outfit in all panels. Natural adult proportions with a slightly enlarged head, chunky shoulders, hands and shoes for readability, no doll or toy joints. Standing/walking body language feels like a normal unarmed passer-by. Friendly slightly irreverent character. Plain ground contact shadow, no city backdrop or extra props unrelated to outfit.
Readability: silhouette and large clothing masses carry identity under the intended vertical-down north-up perspective game camera at height 47m, 42 degree vertical FOV, 1280x800. Do not imply an exact engine screenshot; these are enlarged concept studies. Keep detail deliberately sparse. Soft neutral key light plus subtle cyan/coral edge lighting, keep main local colours and body silhouette readable, no heavy bloom.
Text: only a discreet title at top, as specified per direction.
Text (verbatim): "A — Everyday Commuter".

options.title: B — Corner-Shop Regular
options.details: Subject: middle-aged civilian woman with light skin, rounded silver-grey curly hair mass and a fuller everyday build. Long cobalt-blue open coat with broad rounded lapels over a muted amber sweater, petrol straight trousers and coral practical shoes. A small plain warm ivory soft shopping tote hangs close from one hand. No skirt, robe or superhero cape. Silhouette: broader pear-shaped torso and long clean coat hem reaching mid-thigh; comfortable grounded stride. Tote must remain clearly separate from the leg in the overhead silhouette.

options.title: C — Off-Shift Worker
options.details: Subject: adult civilian man with medium tan skin, broad stocky everyday build and a plain petrol baseball cap with short broad brim. Short amber-orange work jacket with one broad cobalt shoulder panel, rolled cuffs, slate loose straight work trousers and dark chunky boots with warm ivory soles. No safety helmet, vest, uniform insignia, tool belt, tools or tactical pouch. Hands free. Silhouette: widest squared upper torso of the three directions, cap brim shows facing from above, broad forearms and separated chunky shoes. Looks like someone walking home from an ordinary workshop.
